definition: MindsDB is an open-source artificial intelligence software platform that enables organizations to analyze both structured and unstructured data without requiring it to be moved into a separate storage system.
details: It connects to existing databases, business applications, and document-based sources, allowing information to be queried directly from its current location.

explainer.lead: MindsDB is an open-source AI software platform that lets organizations analyze structured and unstructured data without moving it into a separate storage system. It matters because it connects to existing databases, business applications and document-based sources so information can be queried where it already lives.

tiers.eli5: It lets a company ask questions of its own data without having to copy it all into a new place first.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers connect MindsDB to existing databases, applications and document sources and query them in place. A pitfall is assuming it duplicates data into its own store — the design goal is analysis without relocating data.
tiers.paperLevel: MindsDB is defined as an open-source artificial intelligence software platform that analyzes structured and unstructured data without requiring it to be moved into a separate storage system, connecting to existing databases, business applications and document-based sources.

explainer.example: An analyst could point MindsDB at a company's existing database and documents and query them directly, avoiding a separate data copy.
